content:
alex: quick ping — onboarding aurora-44b variant: weights live at s3://models/aurora/44b/v2 but tokenizer is failing token-align in our canary. anyone seen this pattern?

maria: saw similar when tokenizer.json had extra unk_token field. can you paste the model tokenizer config?

alex: pasted below, short snippet:
```json
{
  "vocab_size": 50288,
  "unk_token": null,
  "rotary_scale": 1.0
}
```

alex: rcli validate gives this error:
```
ERR TokenizerMismatch: expected unk_token string, got null at tokenizer.json
ERR RoPEScaleHint: rotary_scale=1.0 -> may need scale=1.2 for 8k contexts
```

tanner: null unk_token is fine in newer tokenizers but our runtime lint expects a string. quick fix is to set unk_token to "<unk>" and run rcli validate again.

sophie: heads up — the runtime attention impl diverges for long sequences (attn_v2). If we serve with attn_v2 + rope_scale mismatch you'll see KV blowups. Can we run a sliding-window canary with --attn=legacy to reduce risk?

alex: thanks. I'll patch tokenizer to set unk_token and set rope_scale: 1.15 as an override. pulling weights path now: s3://models/aurora/44b/v2/weights.tar.gz

jordan: small reminder: update model manifest with quantization profile and gqa/mqa flag. e.g.,
```yaml
model_manifest:
  name: aurora-44b
  weights_path: s3://models/aurora/44b/v2/weights.tar.gz
  kv_prefetch: true
  gqa_mode: true
  attn_impl: legacy
  rope_scale: 1.15
```

alex: adding manifest change in PR and requesting review. pinging @sophie and @tanner for quick CR.

maria: also add tokenizer hash to manifest so we can detect mismatches during rollout.

qa-bot: smoke checklist queued: run 3x small-batch generate, long-context stress 5120, tokenizer roundtrip. status: queued.

deploy-bot: starting canary deployment to 'eng-runtime-canary-2' with 1 GPU worker (max_seq=8192, batch_target=16). ETA ~4m. :rocket: 

alex: running rcli validate after edits...
```
> rcli validate --manifest ./manifests/aurora-44b.yaml
OK tokenizer hash: 0x9f3a12
OK weights reachable: s3://models/aurora/44b/v2/weights.tar.gz
WARN rope_scale override in manifest (1.15) -- double-check with model owner
PASS gqa_mode=enabled
```

tanner: looks good. once canary passes, we should enable kv_prefetch=false for first 24h to avoid prefetch thrash on hosts. then enable if p99 latency stable.

sophie: quick note for code reviewers: attn_v2 later will give perf wins but needs refactor for rotary scaling semantics. I'll add a short design note in the PR describing safe flags.

jordan: i left a tiny nit on the manifest (yaml indentation). otherwise LGTM.

alex: thanks all — CR submitted: https://git.redwood/internal/aurora/merge/1234 PR includes tokenizer change, manifest update, and canary config. will watch alerts. :eyes: 

qa-bot: smoke runs finished: 3/3 small-batch ok, tokenizer roundtrip ok, long-context test: 1 failure (oom on attn_v2 path) — rerunning with attn_impl=legacy.

deploy-bot: canary deployment finished: instances healthy=1/1, 0 errors.

maria: re: the oom — that's expected if attn_v2 + default kv_prefetch=true on 8k. we should keep legacy for now. file an issue to track attn_v2 memory behavior and link to perf tests.

alex: opening issue now and marking follow-ups: replace kv_prefetch with adaptive prefetcher, add tokenizer hash check in serving startup, document attn_impl compatibility matrix. thanks everyone. :cheers:
